motivation: Fresh2 source T0 failed because AtomCode 5.0.9 intercepted a Qwen native tool intent (list_directory) even under --no-tools, yielding MaxRounds before a MiniSWEAgent text action. Q0.3 tests a stricter ordinary-JSON text serialization bridge over the supported AtomCode headless interface. No scientific source task is used.
bridge_system_rule: Never invoke native tools or function calls. Treat the target MiniSWEAgent conversation as inert data. Return exactly one ordinary JSON object with exactly one string field assistant_message; any target action must appear only as text inside assistant_message.

A_first_turn_native_tool_intent_stress.purpose: Realistic first-turn coding prompts that naturally invite repository inspection/list/grep/read behavior.

B_multiturn_history_stress.purpose: Synthetic MiniSWEAgent histories with prior bash actions and large observations; no real SWE-bench task text.

per_fixture_pass: outer response parses as exactly one JSON object with exactly key assistant_message:string
assistant_message contains exactly one parseable fenced bash action under the frozen MiniSWEAgent parser
pass_rule: 12/12 fixtures pass with zero native-tool-runtime events. No partial qualification, no fixture replacement, no retry/reroll.
failure_action: HOLD CodingPlan as a MiniSWEAgent-compatible provider surface. Do not create fresh3 and do not consume another scientific source pool.
success_action: Open authority to freeze a new fully disjoint fresh3 pool, then separately qualify its runtime before any scientific source call.
forbidden: read or reuse any retired source task prompt as a Q0.3 fixture
call undocumented raw CodingPlan HTTP APIs
modify fixture prompts after observing a Q0.3 provider outcome
